verdicts.note: Says he has served 5.5 years as commissioner (S1); won the seat in 2022 with 65.14% (S2); 30-year law-enforcement career; goal to 'see current projects through completion' (S1).

'Being a good steward of your tax dollars means focusing on efficiency and accountability in all levels of county operations' (S1) is a single clear audit/restraint statement, so medium. The competitive-pay plank in the same statement pulls toward pole_b and justifies -1 rather than -2. The 2025 veterans relief fund vote (S4) was about process (a rushed policy), not spending level, and is correctly not used. Display notes: the race_blurb's 'seeking a second full term' and the summary's 'commissioner since about 2021' are inferred from 'served 5.5 years' (S1) plus the 2022 win (S2). The dossier never says he was appointed in 2021 or that 2022 was his first full-term election. The blurb could say 'who says he has served 5.5 years' instead. Also, Griffin's highlights say he 'did not answer questions at the July candidate forum [S3]', but per the contest file Burrows didn't answer either (S6 in his dossier), and his card doesn't say so. Either mention it on both cards or on neither.
First-time candidate offering 40 years of private-sector work as a change from the incumbent (S1). +1 rather than +2 is right since he makes no generational or outsider-renewal argument.
